sha brgya zan brgya'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs so/༈na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ban bon byad kha mthu gtad sogs don chen po dang*/lhag par mi dang rta phyugs

tei:div.tei:p: sha brgya zan brgya'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs so/ ༈ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ ban bon byad kha mthu gtad sogs don chen po dang*/ lhag par mi dang rta phyugs kyi nad gdon glo bur bzlog pa la ched du bsngags pa'i sha brgya zan brgya'i glud gtong tshul ni/ pad+ma dbang chen lta bu'i yi dam gang byed chos srung dang bcas pa'i mchod gzhi'i mdun du/ stegs nag po'i dbus su bsrung bya mi phyugs gang yin dang mthun pa'i 'dra glud skye mched dod cing rgyan dang bcas pa/ bdun nam lnga'i mtha' bskor du yul 'brog gi yo byad dang gzugs 'gros srid tshad 'byor tshad kyi gzugs dang*/ la rdzas klung rdzas/ dar zab snam ras 'bru nag rin chen zas sna sogs dngos su 'byor pa rnams dngos su bzhag /rta khal drel khal spre'u g.yag khal du ma bya/ de dag gi phyogs bzhi'i shar du bag zan gyi spre'u dkar po khal bkal ba keng rus kyis 'ded mi/ lhor rta dmar khal bkal ba btsun pa zhwa dmar gyon pas 'ded pa/ nub tu drel nag khal bkal ba btsun pa zhwa ser gyon pas 'ded pa/ byang du mdzo rog khal bkal ba sgrub pa po dom ra can gyis 'ded pa/ bzhi ka'ang rgyab tu 'bog khur ba/ phyogs bzhi so sor changs bu'am theb kyu sha dmar gyis brgyan pa nyer lnga re dkor cha dang bcas pa bsham/ gal te byad kha zlog pa lta bu'i dgos pa 'brel nas zor byed na/ dmar gtor mtshe yungs kyis brgyan pa brgyad dam bzhi'am gcig gang 'byor yi dam gyi gtor ma'i mdun du bsgrig /phyogs gang bder rin po che'i snod du gser skyems gtsang ma dang*/ gu gul yungs thun rol mo sogs 'du bya/ mchod gtor rnams spos chab kyis phyung*/ yi dam chos srung gi gzhung bsrang*/ skong tshogs sogs grub pa dang*/ yas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs rgyas par bya/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs shing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'am/ yul phyogs 'di'i mi phyugs lta bu skabs thob kha bsgyur/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i byad kha rbod gtong nad rims dal yams glo bur ye 'drogs kyi bdag po bdag mo lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba thams cad skad cig yud tsam la lan chags glud kyi gtor ma len pa'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas rten dang gnyis med du 'khod cing sgrub pa pos ci bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par bsam/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: dang po rgyal byung gang nas byung : sogs nas/ su dang 'phrad pa de la sgyur: ces pa'i bar gyer la/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa sogs kyi tshig mtshams su mchod g.yog pas glud gtor rnams phyogs bzhi so sor bsdus/ tshig mtha'i rol 'og tu phyogs ma nor bar skyel/ zor mi byed na mtshams gcod bsrung 'khor byas nas rjes chog la 'jug cing zor byed na/ yi dam gyi zlog sngags bzlas pas zor byin gyis brlabs la/ bh+yoḥ bdag la phur pa'i dbal kha sogs lan grangs gsum lnga bdun sogs brjod/ gzhung gi chad mdo btang*/ gser skyems spyi 'tshams 'bul mthar/ yi dam chos skyong gi bskul zlog dmigs bsal yod na de dang*/ med na/ bh+yoḥ mdos zor sha khrag lta bu spyi 'tshams gyi zlog pa 'don la phyogs bzhi'am/ gnyan po rgyu ba'i gdong ma thug pa'i gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phangs la brtan ma bskyang*/ gtor snod sbub la rta bro brdung*/

zor yod med gang ltar tshe 'gugs rgyas pa bya/ rjes kyi bya ba bkra shis bcas spyi ltar bya ba ni lag len gyi rgyun ma chad la khungs btsun rang bzo ma 'dres pa'i gto chog khyer bde byin rlabs dang ldan pa yin no// zhes pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bris pa gzhan la phan par gyur cig// /
